name: Evenicle Rance
original_name: イブニクル・ランス版
source:
If the protagonist of Evenicle was Rance...

Was a pre-order bonus which stars Rance as the main character instead of Aster through the events of Evenicle up to the end of chapter 1.
translation:
如果埃文尼克的主角是兰斯的话……

这是一个预购奖励，在《埃文尼克》的事件中直到第一章结束，主角都是兰斯而不是艾斯特。
